statement: Meta has evolved since yesterday and will keep evolving daily for about the first week.
Believes the iOS progression curve and prices make more sense because everyone else is hard stuck at the same point.
He is stuck at desert militia, kingdom two expansion and greater education; two upgrades from being fully stuck.

Next node is royal talent points (a sands upgrade) with level one around 33K; not viable and takes forever.

Probably not legitimate screenshots of world four upgrades look easier; thinks world two progression is not right.
iOS prices seem correct since players could pump militia status and get through this roadblock.
Non-iOS players get roughly seven to ten upgrades a day while iOS players speed through the class.
iOS players are getting months ahead because of hard time-gated stacking upgrades.
A golden stopwatch pop won't reset tiny cogs from construction or research observation.
Use 96 silver stopwatches just before reset and let it tick over to force a true reset that procs tiny cogs and RG mechanics.
A true reset replenishes world one stores so you can empty them again and level up.
iOS players push these mechanics for extra points and materials giving multiplicative time-gated gains; catching them will be nearly impossible.
Suggests shutting down iOS or capping upgrades at about 50 so the upper bound is not so crazy.
Frustrating for end gamers as Steam players get no upgrades today because prices are aggressive.
Having a good time with the update and world one was fantastic.
This is one of the best ballot weeks ever; all three options are great.
Skill experience bonus gives lots of experience from spelunking caverns which are normally slow.
Pit of Pages talent doesn't work on all characters yet and is broken.
If Pit of Pages worked he would dump all characters in the final cavern and farm EXP at the bank.
Stamina regeneration will almost certainly win the vote because people love it; he doesn't want it badly.

Might do two more rotations to mitigate RNG and failing early.
Kilroy skulls is the option he wants most; Kilroy is now about 10x and more with plus tech and pet.

He voted Kilroy on the merit and it is second place; stamina will win 100%.

Candy may not be working for this spot; mixed reports so test yourself.

Bring a fire bow or similar to the rats spot.

Max Guardian Disciple; level 208 gives 100% uptime and anything over spawns a second one.

Points in Orb of Various Multitude; Regal Intervention reportedly good; Aesthetic Politics max about 1.8x, solid.

Missing talent points: new Belonking boss gives 50, other master classes' notes give points, royal hard hats about 22.
Advanced logistics is about 30-40% less efficient than just getting more guys.

Lava confirmed no reset for these; you'll get hundreds of points, so mid-term pain but long-term don't worry.

For divinity week put all characters on divinity; he has them in the laboratory.

He changed his Royal Guardian over to divinity pre-stacking though he said yesterday he wouldn't.
Stop pre-stacking when the ballot week arrives.
Claim characters sequentially: claim one, buy world five upgrades at Coral Kid for more divinity points, then claim the next.
Use the mindful style, which gives the most points of any style; use the other when out doing other stuff, not when pre-stacking.
Being connected to the lab also counts as present at the divinity altar so you get gains for both.
Upgrade your blessings; divinity gains from blessings are big and many forget them.
God ranks boost blessings if you have the Jade Emporium upgrade; check you have it.

Zenith market buffs lamp 3x; he has it maxed from crystal week though nerfs make it worse.
Dude plus pet would be good for divinity but he doesn't have it.
Class level and slab boosting effects from sailing artifacts add divinity gains.
Vault upgrade gives straight divinity points and cash pumps it; often missed; also a divinity XP gain upgrade.
Divinity sparkies from gem shop give a true multiplier.
PO box gives 18.18% divinity gain.
ES talent also boosts divinity but he can't show it because of pre-stacking.
Stamp bribe boosts divinity point gain by another 30%.
Listed sources get weaker down the list, but like drop rate divinity benefits from every little source adding up.
